label: Tissue Level (TissueVector summary)

provenance.source: AnthroForge preset-layer driver: no mesh instance; consumed by coupling records in library/couplings/

range.endpoint_anchor: driver value only; effects are defined by the coupling records that read it

region.mask_rule: no vertex region: preset-layer driver, not a mesh morph

semantics: The TissueVector's summary value, 0..1. When a character sets it explicitly it overrides the level the regional-tissue coupling derives from the tissue sliders (Chubby / MassSmooth / BellyPot). Presets author it; the TissueDefinition dial moves it implicitly through its targets.
